item.title: EXPRESS: Revitalizing the Grocery Store Experience: An Empirical Study on the Spillover Effects of Experiential Services
item.description:
Özdemir, B., Lim, S.
Grocery retailers increasingly use experiential services to attract customers to their stores. However, it remains unclear whether these services generate positive spillover effects to core grocery sales or cannibalize existing demand. We provide the first empirical evidence by studying a grocery retailer that introduced a taphouse as its first experiential service and examining the underlying mechanisms.
